property_summary: Once an address has locked in a guess, any subsequent lockInGuess by that address must revert (the guess is immutable), so in P a second lockInGuess returns ok=false for every input while mutant M overwrites the guess and returns ok=true.
change_summary: Delete the guard `require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0);` so a caller can overwrite an existing guess/block.
